Regarding remarks of D.D.O. "A" Division, the
undersigned has interviewed Mr. Feng Yah Sien (方雅仙)
the managing director of the firm and he has stated that
the company have no dealings whatsoever with Japanese
sources as they sell only Chinese Native products. Also
no goods have been removed from north of the Creek as the
firm has no cargoes or godown in that area. Mr. Feng
says that he can give no motive at all for the attack
and can only think that it has some connection with the
anonymous letter which he received warning him not to fly
the flag of the National Government.
Enquiries proceeding.

At 7.21p.m. on 12/6/38, C.P.C. 2992 telephoned
this station to the effect that a bomb had exploded
outside the Continental Emporium Nanking Road.

A party of Police consisting of C.I. Barry i/c
Central Station, Insp. Ware, F.S's Thompson and
Potopoff, P.C's Thompson and Crank, C.D.S. 36, a
party of Chinese Police Constables and the under-
signed immediately attended and learnt that at
about 7.15p.m. 12/6/38 a hand grenade was thrown
through the open door of No.345 Nanking Road, The
China Native Products Co., and had exploded against
a show case smashing three panes of glass and
slightly injuring two shop assistants who were
standing nearby. These two men were sent to the
Lester Chinese Hospital where certificates apper-
taining to their injuries were issued as follows:-
(1) Sia Ping Tsaung (谢斌昌): "Laceration of
right toe. Not serious".
(2) Woo Tuh Yue (吴达元): "Mild laceration of
thigh. Not serious".

Enquiries by C.D.S. 36 and the undersigned
ascertained that at 7.15p.m. the two injured men
were standing near the counter of the above shop
when they both noticed an object rolling along the
floor in their direction from the door leading onto
Nanking Road. They had hardly time to realise what
it was before an explosion occurred and injured them
as stated, besides smashing the glass of the show
cases. They both stated that they did not see any-

1938年6月12日下午7:21，华捕2992号致电本捕房，称南京路大陆商场外发生炸弹爆炸。

由中央捕房主管警长巴里（Barry）、韦尔（Ware）巡官、外国特别警员汤普森（Thompson）和波托波夫（Potopoff）、华捕汤普森（Thompson）和克兰克（Crank）、刑事侦缉股36号、一队华捕以及具名人组成的警察队伍立即赶赴现场，获悉约在1938年6月12日下午7:15，一枚手榴弹被扔进南京路345号中国国货公司敞开的大门，撞在一个展示柜上爆炸，震碎了三块玻璃，并轻微伤及站在附近的两名店员。这两人被送往雷士德华人医院，出具的伤情证明如下：
(1) 谢斌昌（Sia Ping Tsaung）：“右脚趾撕裂伤。不严重”。
(2) 吴达元（Woo Tuh Yue）：“大腿轻度撕裂伤。不严重”。

经刑事侦缉股36号和具名人调查查明，下午7:15，两名伤者正站在上述商店的柜台附近，当时他们都注意到一个物体从通往南京路的大门方向沿着地板向他们滚来。他们还没来得及意识到那是什么，就发生了爆炸，如上所述使他们受伤，并震碎了展示柜的玻璃。两人都表示他们没有看到任何人——

There are altogether nine private watchmen employed by the company but only one was on duty at the time, He however, was at the main entrance, No.543, and not at the door through which the grenade was thrown, consequently did not see the assailant. All members of the staff present were questioned but apparently no one saw the thrower.

A search of the shop brought to light the splintered handle of the grenade and several pieces of shrapnel.

The manager of the firm, Mr. Li Ka Nyien (李康年) was interviewed regarding a motive for the attack and he stated that about a month ago a letter had been received by the firm warning them not to fly the flag of the National Government of China. He did not remember who this letter was signed by except that it was some society and had torn it up and taken no notice of it, not reporting it to the Police. Besides this letter nothing further in the way of telephone or written messages had been received.

firm, it is thought that this bombing is a further
expression of warning with a political motive, and will
possibly be followed up with further attacks; a C.P.C.

The Reserve Unit was summoned and attended. A

Later the same evening Wong Ming Kwen, accused

随后所有人逃窜并返回极司菲尔路86号，通过电话向常玉清（Zang Nyeh Tsing）通报了任务结果。

爱文义路近兆丰公园路处有人投掷炸弹。

1938年6月12日晚上7:30，居住于爱文义路1729弄27号（万宜坊）的巡长267号（特别队）韦林斯基（Velinsky）通过电话向警局报告，称有人向该弄堂口投掷了一枚炸弹。

摩尔（Moore）督察、刑事侦缉股第8组、刑事侦缉课警员314号及签署人随即前往现场。当得知消息后，"E"区分局局长贝克（Baker）先生、"B"区助理分局局长克劳奇（Crouch）警司以及高级侦探长图恩森（Toon Sen）立即赶赴现场。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1938年6月13日 / 特别处）

经查询获悉，1938年6月12日晚上7:30左右，一名中国男子将一枚“马铃薯捣碎器”式（即柄式手榴弹）炸弹扔进爱文义路1729弄的弄堂口。炸弹击中并爆炸于距离大门约八英尺处的东墙根部。无人受伤，唯一的财产损失是一条排水沟破裂。

炸弹爆炸处的对面有一个更夫棚。炸弹爆炸时，弄堂清洁工李阿三（Lee Ah Sai）正在棚内。他听到爆炸声，跑到弄堂口，看见投掷者向西奔跑，穿过爱文义路，然后向北转入兆丰公园路。对投掷者的描述如下：

“一名中国男子，年龄不详，中等身材，体格强壮，短发，身穿蓝色苦力服，头戴浅棕色草帽。”

后来在爱文义路1729弄几乎正对面的地方发现了那顶帽子，并从坐在静止公交车上的警员62号孟庆元（Mung Ching Yuin，**〔此处转录不清〕**）处获悉……

SHANGHAI TIMES.
SEP 2 2 1938

Terrorists In Court Tell
Of Several Failures

Two Additional Members Of “Yellow Way” Group
Recount Punishments Administered By Chief
When Assassinations Were Not Success

Interesting revelations regarding the activities of the “Yellow Way Society,” an anti-Hankow terrorist gang, including the futile attempt at assassinating a Chinese school principal and the private imprisonment of members of the society who failed to carry out their mission, were made yesterday in the First Special District Court when two more members of the society were brought up for trial and charged with offences against public order and attempted murder. They were charged on six counts. Both accused frankly admitted all crimes, but further hearing was postponed sine die pending further investigations.

The two new accused were arrested recently after Yang Chia-tseu, a leader of the terrorist gang, was sentenced to life imprisonment having been convicted of beheading Tsai Teu-tu, late general manager of the “Social Evening News,” for his anti-Japanese inspirations. Tsai’s severed head was found in a French Concession street more than six months ago. Three other persons were sentenced to prison terms, together with Yang, in connection with the same crime. Losing no time in rounding up the whole gang the police arrested Wu Deh-fah and Chao Jih-feng.

The police prosecutor told the court that Wu was one of the terrorists who failed to carry out the mission of bombing the Hwa Tung Broadcasting Station, in Ningpo Road, on June 12, when a wave of bombing terrorism created a reign of terror in the Settlement. The hand grenade thrown by the terrorists did not explode and the terrorists were severely punished by their leaders after returning to their society headquarters in Hongkew.

Punished For Failures

Wu was also said to have operated with some other members of the society in investigating the movements of Mr. Su Ken-chieh, principal of the Min Li Middle School, Tifeng Road. He was sent out on June 19 by the chairman of his society, the notorious Zan Yu-chin, to make investigations before carrying out an assassination plot, but there was a storm on that day and Wu again failed in his mission.

Chao was charged on four counts and the crimes he admitted were more serious than those committed by the first accused, it was stated by the prosecution. He was said to have participated in the assassination of Dr. Herman Liu, late president of University of Shanghai on Bubbling Well Road. Although Chao did not actually kill Dr. Herman Liu, he was one of those assigned to plot the assassination but for his work he only received $2.50. A Japanese promised to distribute $1,000 after the men had successfully carried out their plot. One man was arrested and convicted and his family received $500, it was said. The rest of the reward money was divided among other members of the gang.

On May 9 Chao was ordered to throw a hand grenade into Nanking Road from the roof garden of the Wing On Building, but he tossed the missile into the basement and it did not explode. He was promised a higher position in the society if he succeeded in carrying out the order, but his failure brought him only punishment from his leaders. He again failed to cause an explosion outside the Central Trust Bureau, Tientsin Road, on May 10, for which he was again punished.

Courage Fails

The only explosion he caused occurred in front of the “Morning Leader,” in Ningpo Road, on May 20, when a bomb he threw exploded and injured four persons, including a constable. The interior of the newspaper plant was not damaged, however.

Chao was ordered by Zan Yu-chin to continue the investigation of the movements of Mr. Su, of the Min Li Middle School, the work which the first accused failed to finish. After investigating, Chao and three other men were ordered to assassinate Mr. Su. They waited for their victim near his school in Tifeng Road on June 19, but when Mr. Su came out Chao’s hands trembled and could not pull the trigger of his pistol. Mr. Su escaped unscathed. All the four terrorists were punished after returning to their society and they failed to obtain the $500 reward promised by their leaders. Chao received more severe punishment than the three other accomplices since he carried a gun. He was roped and imprisoned for several days.

1938年9月22日

恐怖分子在法庭讲述
多次失败经历

“黄道会”团伙另外两名成员
 recount 首领在暗杀未遂时施加的惩罚

昨日在第一特区法院审理该社团另外两名成员时，揭露了关于“黄道会”（一个反汉口的恐怖团伙）活动的有趣细节，包括刺杀一名中国学校校长的徒劳尝试，以及对未能完成任务的社团成员进行的私下监禁。这两名被告被控犯有妨害公共秩序罪和谋杀未遂罪。他们面临六项指控。两名被告均坦承所有罪行，但因需进一步调查，听证会无限期推迟。

这两名新被告是在该恐怖团伙头目杨家子（Yang Chia-tseu，音译）被判终身监禁后不久被捕的，杨家子因出于反日动机斩首《社会晚报》前总经理蔡德土（Tsai Teu-tu，音译）而被定罪。半年多前，蔡的头颅在法租界的一条街道上被发现。另有三人与杨家子一同因同一罪行被判入狱。警方抓紧时间 roundup 整个团伙，逮捕了吴德发（Wu Deh-fah，音译）和赵日峰（Chao Jih-feng，音译）。

警方检察官告诉法庭，吴是未能执行6月12日轰炸宁波路华通广播电台任务的恐怖分子之一，当时一波炸弹恐怖袭击在租界造成了恐怖统治。恐怖分子投掷的手榴弹未爆炸，他们在返回虹口的社团总部后受到了首领的严厉惩罚。

因失败受罚

据说吴还与其他一些社团成员一起调查民立中学（Min Li Middle School，音译）校长苏干杰（Su Ken-chieh，音译，提丰路）的行踪。6月19日，他被其社团主席、臭名昭著的詹玉金（Zan Yu-chin，音译）派去在执行暗杀阴谋前进行调查，但当天有暴风雨，吴再次未能完成任务。

检方称，赵面临四项指控，他承认的罪行比第一名被告所犯罪行更为严重。据说他参与了在上海大学（University of Shanghai，静安寺路）前校长赫尔曼·刘博士（Dr. Herman Liu）的暗杀行动。虽然赵并未亲手杀害赫尔曼·刘博士，但他是策划暗杀的人员之一，为此他仅获得了2.50美元。一名日本人承诺，在这些人成功执行阴谋后将分发1,000美元。据说一人被捕并被定罪，其家属收到了500美元。其余的赏金在团伙其他成员中分配。

5月9日，赵奉命从永安公司大楼的屋顶花园向南京路投掷手榴弹，但他将武器扔进了地下室，且未爆炸。如果他成功执行命令，曾许诺他在社团中获得更高职位，但他的失败只带来了首领的惩罚。5月10日，他再次未能引起天津路中央信托局外的爆炸，为此再次受到惩罚。

勇气缺失

他造成的唯一一次爆炸发生在5月20日宁波路《晨导报》（Morning Leader，音译）门前，当时他投掷的一枚炸弹爆炸，造成包括一名巡捕在内的四人受伤。然而，报社内部未受损。

詹玉金命令赵继续调查民立中学苏先生的行踪，这是第一名被告未能完成的工作。调查后，赵和另外三人奉命刺杀苏先生。6月19日，他们在提丰路学校附近等待受害者，但当苏先生出来时，赵双手颤抖，无法扣动扳机。苏先生毫发无损地逃脱。这四名恐怖分子回到社团后均受到惩罚，未能获得首领许诺的500美元赏金。由于赵携带枪支，他受到的惩罚比其他三名同伙更为严厉。他被捆绑并监禁了数天。

December 3, 1938. Morning Translation

Standard and other local newspapers :-

THE CASE AGAINST KOO TSOH-CHING, A TERRORIST

Koo Tsoh-ching (顧竺), alias Koo Chao-van (顧超凡)
alias lock-marked Yung Shing (麻皮永興) is a native of Chang-
chow. He was for a time Chief of the Second District and
concurrently Chief of the Propaganda Section of the Asia
Rehabilitation Society (兴亚会), an organization enjoying
the protection of the Japanese. He was arrested for the
abduction of one Zee Ung-wei (徐恩偉), living at 4ee Ka Zah
(徐家宅), Great Western Road, whom he carried off to Hongkew
for ransom. Sung Ai-tsong (孫愛忠), a detective sergeant
attached to Wayside Police Station, and Sung Ching-wen (沈錦文),
another detective sergeant attached to West Hongkew Police
Station, were implicated in the case. These three men were
convicted in the Shanghai First Special District Court and
were sentenced as follows:- Koo Tsoh-ching, 7 years imprison-
ment and fined $1,500 with deprivation of civil rights for
10 years; Sung Ai-tsong fined $1,000; Sung Ching-wen, 6 months
imprisonment and fined $500.
An appeal was filed. During the period of appeal
Koo was detained in custody, while the two ex-detectives were
released on bail.
The appeal came up for hearing before the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court on the afternoon of December
1, when Koo Tsoh-ching requested the Court to hear the case
in camera as a statement which he was about to make should
not be made public. His request was granted.
The nature of Koo's statement is not known. He
spoke for about an hour and a half on the activities of the
Asia Rehabilitation Society and the Huang Dao Association.
The hearing of the case was adjourned.

针对恐怖分子顾竺钦的案件

顾竺钦（Koo Tsoh-ching），别名顾超凡（Koo Chao-van），别名麻皮永兴（lock-marked Yung Shing），常州人。他曾一度担任“兴亚会”第二区区长兼宣传科科长，该组织受日本人庇护。他因绑架居住在极司菲尔路（Great Western Road）徐家宅（4ee Ka Zah，原文不清，疑为徐家宅）的徐恩伟（Zee Ung-wei），并将其劫持至虹口以勒索赎金而被捕。隶属于路边巡捕房的侦探警长孙爱忠（Sung Ai-tsong）和隶属于西虹口巡捕房的另一名侦探警长沈锦文（Sung Ching-wen）也卷入此案。这三人在上海第一特区地方法院被判有罪，判决如下：顾竺钦，有期徒刑七年，罚款1,500元，剥夺公权十年；孙爱忠，罚款1,000元；沈锦文，有期徒刑六个月，罚款500元。
已提出上诉。在上诉期间，顾被羁押，而两名前侦探警长则获保释。
上诉案于12月1日下午在江苏高等法院第二分院开庭审理，当时顾竺钦请求法庭不公开审理此案，因为他即将作出的陈述不应公开。他的请求获准。
顾的陈述内容不详。他就兴亚会和黄道会的活动发言约一个半小时。案件审理延期。

October 7, 1938. Morning Translation.

News Digest and other local newspapers :-

DETECTIVES SENTENCED FOR EXTORTION

On suspicion of being connected with the murder of Tsai Tiao-tu (蔡釣徒), the late proprietor of the "Social Daily News" (社會日報), Koo Tso-ching (顧竺欽) alias Koo Tsao-wei (顧造凡) alias Koo Yung-shing (顧永興), native of Changchow, Chief of the 2nd District and of the Publicity Department of the Asia Rehabilitation Society, was arrested by the Shanghai Municipal Police in front of the Great Eastern Hotel (大东旅館), Ying Hwa Ka (英華街) near Nanking Road on July 21 this year. As a result of enquiries made by the Police, no evidence could be found to convict him with the murder, consequently he was released the same night. His arrest was not known to the public. On July 30, however, a report of his arrest appeared in the "Sin Shun Pao" (新申報), a Japanese owned Chinese language newspaper, in which the good name of the Police was defamed and in which it was alleged that it was due to expectations of making money by means of extortion that the detectives had made the arrest.

Holding the view that the article must have been written by Koo himself with the intention of spoiling the good name of the S.M.P. and with the object of ascertaining the facts, the Police issued orders for his re-arrest. He was arrested at House No. 85 Race Course Road where several thousand copies of handbills of a reactionary nature were seized. He was detained by the Police and as a result of enquiries, it was learned that he was connected with the kidnapping of one Hsu Eng-wei (徐恩偉). During his detention, Koo gave out information that Sung Ai-tsung (孫愛忠), a Detective Sergeant of Wayside Police Station, and Sung Ching-wen (沈錦文), a Detective Sergeant of West Hongkew Police Station, were also connected with this case. Consequently, the two officers were likewise detained.

The case came up for further hearing at the Shanghai First Special District Court yesterday afternoon, when the Police representative made the following statements:-

"During the period of remand, the Police have succeeded in discovering the following evidence:-
"(1) The accused Koo Tso-ching appears in a photograph which was taken at the time of the preparatory meeting of the Asia Rehabilitation Society (兴亚会) on March 22 this year and which was seized by the Police in connection with the case against Yang Ch'a-chu (楊家駒) alias Colonel Yang.
"(2) According to the list of members of the Asia Rehabilitation Society, the accused Koo Tso-ching is the Chief of the 2nd Branch of the Society and his address and other particulars have been found to be identical with those mentioned in the list.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

侦探因敲诈勒索被判刑

因涉嫌与已故《社会日报》老板蔡钓徒（Tsai Tiao-tu）谋杀案有关，顾竺钦（Koo Tso-ching），别名顾造凡（Koo Tsao-wei），别名顾永兴（Koo Yung-shing），常州人，兴亚会第二区区长兼宣传科科长，于今年7月21日在南京路附近的英华街（Ying Hwa Ka）大东旅馆前被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕。经警方调查，未能找到足以定罪其谋杀罪的证据，因此他于当晚获释。公众并不知晓其被捕一事。然而，7月30日，一家日资中文报纸《新申报》刊登了其被捕的报道，文中诋毁警方声誉，并声称侦探之所以实施逮捕，是出于通过敲诈勒索牟利的企图。

警方认为该文章必是顾本人所写，意在破坏上海公共租界工部局警务处的声誉，并为查明事实真相，警方下令将其重新逮捕。他在跑马厅路85号被捕，现场查获数千份具有反动性质的传单。他被警方拘留，经调查得知，他与徐恩伟（Hsu Eng-wei）绑架案有关。在被拘留期间，顾提供信息称，路边巡捕房的侦探警长孙爱忠（Sung Ai-tsung）和西虹口巡捕房的侦探警长沈锦文（Sung Ching-wen）也与此案有关。因此，这两名警官也被拘留。

该案于昨日下午在上海第一特区地方法院继续审理，警方代表作了如下陈述：

“在还押候审期间，警方成功发现了以下证据：
“(1) 被告顾竺钦出现在一张照片中，该照片拍摄于今年3月22日兴亚会预备会议期间，系警方在处理针对杨家驹（Yang Ch'a-chu），即杨上校一案时查获。
“(2) 根据兴亚会成员名单，被告顾竺钦是该会第二区区长，其地址及其他详情经查证与名单中所列一致。

被告孙爱忠提供了如下证词：“我对被绑架者家属支付的20,000元一无所知。虽然顾竺钦想把被绑架者家属给他的1,000元酬金分一半给我，但我拒绝了这笔钱。此外，当我受托处理此事时，我曾强烈建议原告向警方报案，但后者没有听从我的建议。我加入《国民日报》的原因，是我打算从中获取情报，以便提供给警方以及汤浦总部的一名龙（Loong，音译）姓人员。此事我已告知警务处副处长杨先生（Mr. S.C. Young）。后来，当日本当局通过福永得知我是警务处的侦探警长时，他们对我感到不满。因此，我辞去了《国民日报》的职务，由顾竺钦继任。我在本案中没有其他动机，我介入此事纯粹是为了促成被绑架者的释放。”
沈锦文提供了如下证词：“我是受我姐夫陈品三（Chen Ping-san）之托从事此项工作的，因为陆根泉（Loh Keng-zien）和王志仁（Wang Tse-jen）曾请他为他们搜集情报。当时陈品三是一家名为《时代晚报》的晚报记者。我向我的上级报告说，我无法承担这项工作，因为我对案情一无所知。随后，我就此案向原告做了几次查询。当我在华懋饭店（Paramount Hotel）302房间时，陈品三带了一个姓王（Wong）的人到房间，此人自称是‘维新政府’的雇员，但我无法判断这是否属实。这个王某出示了一张由徐恩伟写的便条。我没有看到便条的内容。要求请虞洽卿（Yu Ya-ching）先生调解此案以及更换中国商会旗帜的要求，是由王某提出的。由于谈判失败，我断绝了与此案的联系。后来徐家给了我60元，但我退还给了他们。我对后来陈品三在中国饭店被日本人绑架一事一无所知。”

Koo Tso-ching further stated that the purpose of his joining the Asia Rehabilitation Society was to seek information from the society because after joining it he reported on the meetings of the Asia Rehabilitation Society and showed photos of members of the society to Sung Ai-tsung who transmitted them to Detective Inspector Hill of Chengtu Road Police Station. He added that later he reported to the Police information regarding certain important documents of the Huang Dao Association.

As Koo had made a statement at the Police Station to the effect that on instructions from a Japanese named Kimura (Advisor to the Asia Rehabilitation Society) he had sold $45,000 worth of opium to a certain concern in Po Ling Li (卜鄰里), French Concession, and that he had made a profit of $6,000 out of this transaction, the Police representative charged him under Article 5 of the Opium Suppression Regulations. Koo denied the charge.

The Police representative then requested the Court to punish Koo Tso-ching and Sung Ai-tsung under Article 339 of the Chinese Criminal Code for fraud and to punish Sung Ching-wen under Article 346 of the Code for unsuccessful intimidation. He asked the Court to impose heavy punishment on Koo on charges of dealing in opium and participation in a society whose object is to commit offences. Of the money seized at Koo Tso-ching's home, a sum of $6,500 was the profit made by him from the ransom paid by the complainant and this sum should be returned to the latter. A sum of $6,000 from the money should be confiscated as it was the profit from Koo's dealings in opium and the balance, $2,511, should be returned to him.

The Judge then handed down the following judgment:-
Koo Tso-ching is sentenced to 2 years and 6 months imprisonment for repeated offences of fraud and to pay a fine of $1,500. He is sentenced to 4 years and 6 months imprisonment and deprived of citizenship rights for ten years for having participated in a society whose object is to commit offences. In all, he is sentenced to 7 years imprisonment and to pay fines of $1,500; he is to be deprived of citizenship rights for ten years. If the fine is not paid he will have to serve six months for every $1,500 of the fine. The charge for dealing in opium is dismissed.

Sung Ai-tsung is fined $1,000 for fraud; if the fine cannot be paid he will be imprisoned six months for every $1,000.

Sung Ching-wen is sentenced to 1 year and 8 months imprisonment with a fine of $500 on a charge of unsuccessful intimidation.

From the deposit books seized at the home of Koo Tso-ching, $1,500 will be deducted for the fine and $6,500 will be refunded to the complainant Hsu Yen Sz and the balance will be returned to Koo.

During the period of appeal, Sung Ai-tsung will furnish shop or cash security of $1,000 and Sung Ching-wen will furnish cash or shop security of $2,000.

顾佐清（Koo Tso-ching）进一步陈述称，其加入“亚洲复兴社”（Asia Rehabilitation Society）的目的是为了从该社获取情报，因为加入后，他将“亚洲复兴社”的会议情况向宋爱宗（Sung Ai-tsung）作了报告，并向其展示了该社成员的照片，宋爱宗随即将这些照片转交给了成都路捕房的希尔（Hill）巡官。他补充说，后来他还向警方报告了关于“黄道会”某些重要文件的情报。

由于顾佐清在捕房所作供词中称，受一名叫木村（Kimura）（“亚洲复兴社”顾问）的日本人指使，他在法租界卜鄰里将价值45,000元的鸦片出售给某商号，并从中获利6,000元，警方代表依据《禁烟条例》第五条对他提出指控。顾佐清否认该项指控。

随后，警方代表请求法庭依据《中华民国刑法》第339条以诈骗罪惩处顾佐清和宋爱宗，并依据该法典第346条以恐吓未遂罪惩处宋景文（Sung Ching-wen）。他请求法庭就贩卖鸦片及参与以犯罪为目的之社团的罪名对顾佐清从重处罚。在顾佐清家中搜获的款项中，有6,500元系其从受害人支付的赎金中获得的利润，该笔款项应退还给受害人。另有6,000元应予没收，因为这是顾佐清贩卖鸦片的获利，其余2,511元应退还给他。

法官随即作出如下判决：-
顾佐清因多次犯诈骗罪，被判处有期徒刑二年六个月，并处罚金1,500元。因参与以犯罪为目的之社团，被判处有期徒刑四年六个月，并剥夺公权十年。总计判处有期徒刑七年，并处罚金1,500元；剥夺公权十年。如罚金未能缴纳，每1,500元罚金需服劳役六个月。贩卖鸦片之指控予以驳回。

宋爱宗因诈骗罪被处罚金1,000元；如无法缴纳罚金，每1,000元需服刑六个月。

宋景文因恐吓未遂罪，被判处有期徒刑一年八个月，并处罚金500元。

从顾佐清家中搜出的存折中，扣除1,500元作为罚金，6,500元退还给受害人徐燕四（Hsu Yen Sz），余款退还给顾佐清。

在上诉期间，宋爱宗需提供铺保或现金担保1,000元，宋景文需提供现金或铺保担保2,000元。

所有中央巡逻车警员（C.P.C's）均表示，在听到爆炸声后，他们看到三名男子沿四川路由北向南奔跑，并在他们到达南京路时将其拘留。印度守夜人的陈述仅称他听到爆炸声并看到一团烟雾，随后看到三个人从北面朝南京路跑来，到达南京路时被警察拘留。
日本军方官员已获知此事，其代表出席警局并对两名日本人进行了讯问。日本领事警察也已获知。
两名日本人在完成陈述后离开警局。
后备队 "V" 队出勤并搜查了各类路人、车辆等，但未有结果。

page_data.zh:
马吉·辛格，私人守夜人。
印度人                                      巴顿警司（D.S. Barton）
晚上10:30           1938年6月12日                 特别巡逻车 541号。

    马吉·辛格，私人守夜人，父亲因杜尔·辛格（Indur Singh），村庄纳索贝（Nathobe），邮局巴加（Baga），费罗兹普尔区（Ferozepore）。
    1938年6月12日晚上9点40分左右，我正坐在白礼氏洋行四川路入口内的椅子上，突然听到四川路与静安寺路拐角处炸弹爆炸的声音，并看到一团烟雾。与此同时，我走到路上，看到三名男子在四川路上由北向南奔跑。这些男子到达南京路交叉口时被中央巡逻车警员（C.P.C's）拦下并拘留。
    以上是我的真实陈述。

                                    (签名) 马吉·辛格。

page_data.en:
Shoichiro Tani, age 27, employed by Messrs.
Mitsui Bussan Kaisha No.185 Szechuen Rd.,residing at New Shanghai
Hotel, No.82 Tsungming Rd.
Japanese                                      translated
Central Stn.          12/6/38                 xxxxxxxx      J.D.S. Kobayashi.

At about 9.30p.m. on the 12/6/38 I accompanied with my
comrades Messrs. Watanabe and Yokomizo come out of the our firm
Mitsui Bussan Kaisha and proceeded along Szechuen Road towards
North. After crossing Nanking Road and on approaching the front
of a book store located at the left side of Szechuen Road and
chattering with each other in a loud voice in the middle of the
street, suddenly something like a bomb was thrown about 2 or 3
meters in front of us coming from our left.
As I thought that the bomb was thrown at us therefore at the
time of the explosion, we turned back and ran along Szechuen Rd.
towards Nanking Road. At this time no other persons were seen
behind us.
At the intersection of Nanking and Szechuen Roads we saw
police officers of S.M.P. including 15 or 16 Chinese constables
and 2 or 3 foreign officers pointing their pistols to us, so that
we should halt, consequently we stopped running and held up our
hands. I then called to them in "English" "we are Japanese,
call some Japanese policemen, we want Japanese Policemen."
While I was held up and was being searched, I said to a foreign
policeman in English, "We have been attacked about 300 meters
from here". I also pointed out the scene of the crime with my
hand which were being held up but no attention was paid. None
of the Police constables would attempt to run towards the scene,
remaining standing in front of us and pointing the pistols.
Later, the station van arrived at the scene and I was forced
inside by a foreigner likely to be a detective, this foreigner
also did not pay attention to us.
page_data.zh:
谷庄一郎（Shoichiro Tani），27岁，受雇于四川路185号三井物产株式会社，居住于崇明路82号新上海大酒店。
日本人                                      翻译
中央警局          1938年6月12日                 xxxxxxxx      小林日本侦探警司（J.D.S. Kobayashi）。

1938年6月12日晚上9点30分左右，我与同事渡边先生和横沟先生一起走出我们公司三井物产株式会社，沿四川路向北行进。穿过南京路后，在接近位于四川路左侧的一家书店前时，我们在街道中间大声交谈，突然有一个像炸弹一样的物体从我们左侧投掷到我们前方约2或3米处。
由于我认为炸弹是冲着我们来的，因此在爆炸发生时，我们转身沿四川路向南京路方向跑去。此时我们身后未见其他人。
在南京路与四川路交叉口，我们看到包括15或16名中国巡捕和2或3名外籍警官在内的上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警官用枪指着我们，命令我们停下，因此我们停止奔跑并举起双手。随后我用“英语”向他们喊道：“我们是日本人，叫一些日本警察来，我们要日本警察。”
当我被控制并接受搜查时，我用英语对一名外籍警察说：“我们在离这里约300米的地方遭到了袭击。”我还用举起的手指出了犯罪现场，但未受重视。没有任何巡捕试图跑向现场，而是站在我们面前，用枪指着我们。
后来，警车抵达现场，我被一名可能是侦探的外国人强行推入车内，这名外国人也未理会我们。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

P.S. The bomb was thrown from the shade of the premises in
front of me at about two meters height from the ground., and
was thrown straight from the behind the premises.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

附言：炸弹是从位于我前方约两米高的建筑物遮蔽处投掷出来的，系直接从该建筑物后方投出。

page_data.en:
Geichi Yokomizo, 21, employed at the Account
Dept. of the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, 185 Szechuen Road.
Japanese                                Self written
Central Stn.        12/6/38        translated J.D.S. Kobayashi.
                     xxxxxxxx

After having dinner at the office on June 12, 1938, I left
for home at about 9.30p.m. together with Messrs. Watanabe and
Tani. We walked along Szechuen Road towards the Szechuen Road
Bridge. When we arrived at a point on Szechuen Road after
crossing Nanking Road, where the road on the left hand side just
beyond a book store, is being widened, I saw an article which
appeared to be a long and narrow tube thrown out. My friends
immediately ran away in the direction from where we came. Think-
ing that the article was a hand grenade, I ran after them. We
ran away in the same direction as we came because we thought
if we ran forward we might be shot by a pistol or a second bomb
might be thrown. We might have been injured or killed if we
ran away in a forward direction. I think there were one or two
Chinese in the vicinity at the time but the scene was very dark
lonely. There was no policeman, when we approached Nanking Rd.
Chinese policemen, taking us as culprits, pointed their pistols
at us. I did not want to cause excitement as I thought the
matter would be cleared up if Japanese members of the S.M.P.
or Japanese Consular Police officers arrived. I pointed out
the scene for I feared that the culprit or culprits might escape.
It is matter for regret that I could not make the policemen
understand owing to language difficulties. I told them we were
Japanese and asked them to call Japanese policemen but this was
not understood. We were treated as the culprits. It is a pity
that no Chinese policeman attempted to go to the scene of the
crime. I think the culprit or culprits escaped in the confusion
that followed. We were taken to the station before the arrival
page_data.zh:
横沟桂一（Geichi Yokomizo），21岁，受雇于四川路185号三井物产株式会社会计部。
日本人                                自述
中央巡捕房        1938年6月12日        由小林（Kobayashi）翻译 J.D.S.
                     xxxxxxxx

1938年6月12日晚在办公室用罢晚餐后，我与渡边（Watanabe）先生和谷（Tani）先生一同于晚上9点30分左右启程回家。我们沿着四川路朝四川路桥方向行走。当我们穿过南京路，到达四川路上书店左侧道路正在拓宽的一处地点时，我看见一个看似细长袖筒状的物体被扔了出来。我的朋友们立即向来时的方向逃去。我想那物体是一枚手榴弹，便跟着他们跑去。因为我们担心如果向前跑可能会遭到手枪射击或第二枚炸弹的投掷，所以我们朝着来时的同一方向逃跑。如果我们向前方逃跑，可能会受伤或丧命。我想当时附近有一两名中国人，但现场非常昏暗且人迹罕至。当我们接近南京路时，周围没有警察。中国巡捕将我们视为罪犯，用枪指着我们。我不愿引起骚动，因为我认为如果公共租界工部局警务处的日本警员或日本领事馆警察赶到，事情就会澄清。我指出了事发地点，因为我担心罪犯可能逃脱。遗憾的是，由于语言障碍，我无法让巡捕们理解。我告诉他们我们是日本人，并请他们呼叫日本警察，但他们未能理解。我们被当作罪犯对待。可惜没有中国巡捕试图前往犯罪现场。我想罪犯在随后的混乱中逃脱了。在日本警员到达之前，我们被带往巡捕房

page_data.en:
- 2 -
of my Japanese policeman. I regret the attitude of the
Chinese policeman who treated us as culprits and also the
attitude of the officers who failed to give immediate treat-
ment to Mr. Watanabe who was injured.
Owing to excitement I cannot concentrate my mind to-night
so I shall be pleased to demonstrate what had happened on the
scene of the crime on some other day .
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
对此我感到遗憾。我对中国巡捕将我们视为罪犯的态度，以及对未能对受伤的渡边先生给予即时救治的警官们的态度表示遗憾。
由于情绪激动，我今晚无法集中精神，因此我很乐意改日在犯罪现场演示当时发生的情况。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 75 - Tsu Sih Ping.
Self written

Whilst I was on duty on Nanking Road near Szechuen Road,
at 9.40p.m. on 12/6/38, I suddenly heard a sound of explosion.

(Sgd) Tsu Sih Ping.
page_data.zh:
中国巡捕 C.P.C. 75 - 朱世平（Tsu Sih Ping）。
自述
中央巡捕房        1938年6月12日        书记员吴（Woo）。

1938年6月12日晚上9点40分，当我在南京路靠近四川路处执勤时，突然听到一声爆炸响。转身时，我看见三名男子在南京路以北约30码处的四川路西侧，匆忙向南奔跑。随后我将他们扣留并带往巡捕房。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 2915 - Woo Shoh Zung.
Self written.
Central Stn.           12/8/38           Clerk Woo.

At 9.40p.m. on 12/8/38 whilst I was on Traffic Duty at the
intersection of Nanking and Szechuan Roads, I suddenly heard an
explosion and then saw a cloud of smoke on Szechuan Road near
Jinken Road, wherefrom three men ran hurriedly on the West side
along Szechuan Road towards Nanking Road. When they arrived
at Nanking and Szechuan Roads intersection I drew out my pistol
and stopped them. In the meantime other C.P.C's rushed to the
scene from various directions and assisted me in taking them
into custody, after which I immediately reported the matter to
the station by telephone.

Sgd: Woo Shoh Zung.
page_data.zh:
中国巡捕 C.P.C. 2915 - 吴绍宗（Woo Shoh Zung）。
自述。
中央巡捕房           1938年6月12日           书记员吴（Woo）。

1938年6月12日晚上9点40分，当我在南京路与四川路交叉路口执行交通勤务时，突然听到一声爆炸，随即看见四川路靠近静安寺路（Jinken Road）处升起一团烟雾，三名男子从那里沿四川路西侧匆忙向南京路方向跑去。当他们到达南京路与四川路交叉路口时，我拔出手枪将他们拦住。与此同时，其他中国巡捕从各个方向赶赴现场，协助我将他们拘捕，随后我立即通过电话向巡捕房报告了此事。

签名：吴绍宗（Woo Shoh Zung）。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 27 - Dee Zang Tsung.
Self written.
Central Stn.        12/6/38        Clerk Woo.

At 9.40pm. on 12/6/38 when I was on duty at Nanking and
Kiangse Roads Intersection I heard a great noise coming from
the direction of Szechuen Road North of Nanking Road, and then
saw several civilians running from Central Road in an easterly
direction. I then drew out my pistol and ran towards Nanking
and Szechuen Roads corner where I observed three males in
foreign clothes standing on the South side of Nanking Road West
of Szechuen Road all with their hands up. I then pointed my
pistol at one of them and later detained him as ordered by a
plainclothes foreign police officer. A few minutes later a
station car came on the scene and brought all concerned to the
station.

(Sgd) Dee Zang Tsung.
page_data.zh:
中国巡捕 C.P.C. 27 - 狄章宗（Dee Zang Tsung）。
自述。
中央巡捕房        1938年6月12日        书记员吴（Woo）。

1938年6月12日晚上9点40分，当我在南京路与江西路（Kiangse Roads）交叉路口执勤时，听到从南京路以北的四川路方向传来巨大的声响，随后看见几名平民从中央路（Central Road）向东奔跑。于是我拔出手枪，跑向南京路与四川路的拐角处，在那里观察到三名身穿西式服装的男子站在四川路以西、南京路南侧，双手举过头顶。随后我将手枪指向其中一人，并按照一名便衣外籍警官的命令将其扣留。几分钟后，一辆巡捕房汽车抵达现场，将所有相关人员带往巡捕房。

（签名）狄章宗（Dee Zang Tsung）。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 1376 - Kwok Sih Poh.
self written
Central Stn.        12/6/58        Clerk Woo.

At 9.40p.m. on 12/6/58 whilst I was on duty at No.299, 330,
and 333 Szechuen Road (Japanese shops) I suddenly heard a great
noise and at the same time saw three males running quickly from
North to South on Szechuen Road north of Nanking Road. I then
ran towards Nanking and Szechuen Roads corner and arrested one
of the men in foreign clothes. This man was later brought to
the station by station car.

(Sgd) Kwok Sih Poh.

中国巡捕 C.P.C. 1376 - 郭世宝（Kwok Sih Poh）。
自述

1938年6月12日晚上9点40分，当我在四川路299号、330号和333号（日本商店）执勤时，突然听到巨大的声响，同时看见三名男子在南京路以北的四川路上从北向南快速奔跑。随后我跑向南京路与四川路的拐角处，逮捕了一名身穿西式服装的男子。该男子后来由巡捕房汽车带往巡捕房。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 3234 - Yang Zeu Sien.
self -written.
Central 3th. 12/6/38 Clerk Woo.

At 7p.m. on 12/6/38 I was despatched for patrol duty on
Nanking Road between the Bund and Szechuen Road. At 9.40p.m.
even date, when I was walking in front of Watson's Pharmacy
about 60 yards away from Szechuen Road, I suddenly heard a great
noise coming from Szechuen Road near Nanking Road. I immediate-
ly ran towards Nanking and Szechuen Roads corner where I observed
three men running hurriedly from North to South on Szechuen Road.
At this moment other C.P.C's also came to the place and took
the fleeing men into custody and later brought them to the
station in a Station car.

(Sgd) Yang Zeu Sion.
page_data.zh:
中国巡捕 C.P.C. 3234 - 杨祖贤（Yang Zeu Sien）。
自述。
中央三分局。1938年6月12日 书记员吴（Woo）。

1938年6月12日晚上7点，我被派往外滩与四川路之间的南京路执行巡逻任务。同日晚上9点40分，当我走到距离四川路约60码的屈臣氏大药房（Watson's Pharmacy）门前时，突然听到从靠近南京路的四川路方向传来巨大的声响。我立即跑向南京路与四川路的拐角处，在那里观察到三名男子在四川路上从北向南匆忙奔跑。此时其他中国巡捕也赶到现场，将逃跑的男子拘捕，随后用巡捕房汽车将他们带往巡捕房。

（签名）杨祖贤（Yang Zeu Sion）。

page_data.en:
C.P.C. 3294 - Fong Tsao Ching.
self written
Central Stn.      12/6/38            Clerk Woo.

At 9.40p.m. on 12/6/38 whilst I was on duty at Szechuen and
Jinkee Roads corner, I suddenly heard an explosion coming from
the direction of Szechuen Road South of Jinkee Road, about 30
yards away. Owing to rain there were few pedestrians on the
roadway, and I saw three males in foreign clothes ran quickly
from North to South towards Nanking Road. I then chased behind
them and on reaching Nanking Road they were stopped by a C.P.C.
on duty there, and we then detained them.

(Sgd) Fong Tsao Ching.
page_data.zh:
中国巡捕 C.P.C. 3294 - 冯兆清（Fong Tsao Ching）。
自述
